1.title: What Is Phantom Ranch? Inside the Grand Canyon Lodge Hit by Flash Flooding
1.summary: Phantom Ranch, the only lodge within the Grand Canyon, has drawn adventurers and dignitaries, including Theodore Roosevelt, for more than a century.

2.title: One Dead and 15 Potentially Missing at Grand Canyon After Flash Flood
2.summary: At least 62 people were evacuated on Saturday after flooding destroyed footbridges and damaged a campground and cabins near Bright Angel Creek in Arizona, the National Park Service said.

3.title: Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial: Jury Deliberations Expected to Continue
3.summary: Jurors have already discussed the high-profile case for about 10 hours over two days.

4.title: Passengers stranded as strike disrupts flights at Kenya's main airport
4.summary: Kenya Airways says the strike has caused delays of more than six hours, with some flights cancelled.

5.title: Survivors of Cyprus Ferry Sinking Describe a Harrowing Escape
5.summary: “My daughter slipped away from my hands,” one survivor told a Turkish news channel.

6.title: South African airline defends low-altitude aerial stunt over packed stadium
6.summary: Airlink says the manoeuvre with two planes in close formation involved careful and precise planning.
